<title level="1" right="Class Feature 19">[Final Gate](/Classes.aspx?ID=23)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 13

**Class** Kineticist
</column>

---

Your kinetic gate reaches a perfect form, its power constantly fighting to be released. If your kinetic aura is inactive, you automatically use the first action of your turn to [Channel Elements](/Actions.aspx?ID=2124) as a free action. You can deliberately suppress the effect. If you're unable to act, final gate still functions, but you don't get to use the [Elemental Blast](/Actions.aspx?ID=2125) or stance impulse you normally do from using Channel Elements.
name: Final Gate
